summary: Architectural blueprint and implementation plan to elevate NotenPilot into a full-stack German student platform using React 19, Vite, TypeScript, and Supabase. Covers preserving the existing public grade calculator, adding Supabase Auth, Row Level Security, Student Notes Manager, Subjects & Grade History, Exam & Study Planner, Flashcards with spaced repetition, and Pomodoro Focus Timer with strict German privacy standards and AdSense readiness.
